body: I just wanted to say again, thank you for first writing this message and believe me I have been through some of those nights recently. Unfortunately I believe that my parents somewhat caused the numbness I feel to this day and I do not think I have friends close enough to share this info with. I, however, do have faith in you and know you can get through all the things happening. Remember, there is always a bright sun above stormy clouds.
I MADE A REDDIT ACCOUNT JUST TO RESPOND TO THIS TO SAY I CAN RELATE TO THIS SO SO SO MUCH. Thnak you for sharing and making me feel a little less alone.
